annotations.title: How long someone has to appeal, and how fast the plan must decide

description: Appeal My Claim. How long someone has to appeal, and how fast the plan must decide. For requests like "how long do I have to appeal?", "when is my appeal due?" or "how fast does my insurer have to answer?". With the date on the denial notice, gives an approximate file-by date. The date on the user's own notice is the one that counts.

denial_date.description: Date on the denial notice, like 2026-09-01, 09/01/2026 or September 1, 2026.

plan_type.description: Same values as plan_type in get_appeal_rights. Default: most private plans.

urgent.description: Set to yes if waiting could seriously harm the person's health.
